data_provenance: SSC CGL Tier 2 Paper I pattern as reported by PhysicsWallah/Adda247/CareerPower (Sep 2026): 150 Q / 450 marks / 135 minutes Session 1 — Mathematical Abilities 30, Reasoning 30, English 45, GA 25, Computer Knowledge 20; +3/−1. DEST Session 2 is qualifying only. Confirm against ssc.gov.in before production use.
important_caveat: Paper I is merit-deciding. Computer Knowledge has its own qualifying cut-off. DEST (Session 2) is out of scope for this MCQ bank. Paper II (Statistics) and Paper III (Finance) are post-specific and out of scope.

exam_day.note: Paper I Session 1 CBT (2h15m) across five graded modules; Session 2 DEST 15 min (qualifying only).

Paper_1.label: SSC CGL Tier 2 Paper I
Paper_1.overall_difficulty: Harder than Tier 1; Maths and multi-condition Reasoning skew hardest

section_1_single_correct.note: SSC CGL Tier 2 Paper I is 5-option single-correct MCQ only. Per-section sizes in all_subjects_table.

marking.note: Computer Knowledge also has a separate qualifying cut-off. DEST is qualifying only and not part of 450 marks.

question_types_note: SSC CGL Tier 2 Paper I uses only 5-option single-correct MCQ. DEST typing test is excluded from this bank.
